title: Does one scoring run cover both hidden partitions (~240 tasks) in the 12-hour window?

first.author: Hitesh Kumar
first.body:
Hi @elanlearns,
I have following query related to scoring. 
Does one scoring run cover both hidden partitions (~240 tasks) within the 12-hour window, or is each partition a separate run? It decides the safe per-task time limit: about 4.5 minutes for 120 tasks, 2 minutes for 240.

comments.author: Ryan Holbrook
comments.body: There are ~120 tasks in the test set, or about 60 in each of the public and private splits. They are scored during the same 12-hour run.

note: Returned comments may be a partial page; organizer claims distinguished from participant reports.
